name: Bloodmage Apotheosis converts damage dealt into healing (#7430)
contract: #7430: Apotheosis buff up, rage draining, zero healing. Cause: both ranks (804195/804203) carry a lone aura-354 effect, which is inert without a handler, and both records have ProcFlags 0 with no spell_proc row, so no proc entry existed and no AuraScript was bound - the buff sat dead. Fix: rev_20261018_36 adds proc rows (all damage-done flags; SchoolMask 32 shadow-only for 804195, Cooldown 1000 once-per-second for 804203) and binds aura_ascension_bloodmage_apotheosis, which heals 100% of dealt damage through each rank's own trigger heal (807857/807934). Rank 804203 (req 40, reporter's level band) is the probe: melee swings deal damage, each dealing swing procs the heal. Fails pre-fix (no healing ever lands).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Top rage back up before swinging
SETUP: the swings dealt melee damage
DISCRIMINATING: Apotheosis healed off the dealt damage
